2121338681571328368.en_summary: Despite recent overwhelming negativity, supply-constrained demand from $LITE to $MU can persist amid possible AI capex slowdowns. A Korean memory executive analogy: a full restaurant with 30 people lined up means five leaving does not free a table. Bottlenecks and price hikes can continue through capacity buildouts. Over the next 5-10 years AI will impact medicine, physics, materials, robotics, cybersecurity, engineering, energy and AI itself; the world will need much more compute as we are only at the start of the next paradigm shift.
2121338681571328368.zh_summary: 儘管近期負面情緒壓倒性，$LITE至$MU的供應受限需求在可能的AI資本支出放緩中仍可持續。一位韓國記憶體高管比喻：餐廳已滿且30人排隊，5人離開不會騰出桌子。瓶頸和價格上漲可在產能建設中持續。未來5-10年AI將影響醫學、物理、材料、機器人、網絡安全、工程、能源及AI本身；世界將需要更多算力，因為我們只處於下一個範式轉移的起點。
